title: Light it up
brief: The bench supply is set to 5 V. Run its red lead to a red + rail and its black lead to a blue − rail.
Then build the schematic: + → the resistor → the LED → −. The LED's long leg (anode) faces +.
Hover any hole to see everything it's connected to. A column of five holes (a–e, or f–j) is one strip.
lesson: An LED on its own would take all the current the supply can give and burn out. The resistor sets the current: (5 V − 2 V) ÷ 330 Ω ≈ 9 mA.
